title: Specification-Guided Generation for Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.41511v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can generate structured outputs, but existing constrained-decoding methods mainly enforce syntax and cannot directly enforce satisfaction of a formal specification. We introduce a neuro-symbolic, specification-guided decoding framework that combines LLM generation with symbolic reasoning. At each step, the framework refines the decoding grammar by filtering out values that cannot be extended to an output satisfying the specification. We present a forward-only variant that guarantees specification satisfaction by construction, and a backtracking variant that revises earlier feasible choices when their downstream consequences leave only values that the LLM itself judges unsuitable. The framework is model-agnostic, requires no retraining, and builds on existing grammar-constrained decoding mechanisms. translated_title: 面向大语言模型的规范引导生成
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）能够生成结构化输出，但现有的受限解码方法主要只强制语法正确，无法直接强制输出满足形式化规范。我们提出了一种将神经生成与符号推理相结合的规范引导解码框架。在每一步，该框架通过过滤掉那些无法扩展为满足规范的输出取值来精化解码语法。我们提出了一个仅前向的变体，可在构造上保证输出满足规范；还提出了一个回溯变体，当早期可行选择的下游后果导致只剩下大语言模型自身认为不合适的取值时，会修改这些早期选择。该框架与具体模型无关，无需重新训练，并构建在现有的语法受限解码机制之上。在配置生成与约束求解基准上的实验表明，仅前向变体能够可靠地产出……（原文摘要此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一种神经符号结合的规范引导解码框架，通过前向过滤与回溯两种变体，在不重新训练模型的前提下保证大语言模型生成的结构化输出满足形式化规范。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a neuro-symbolic specification-guided decoding framework that guarantees LLM-generated structured outputs satisfy formal specifications without retraining, via forward-only filtering and backtracking variants.
